title: A Rare Look Inside the Fly-In Neighborhood Business Model
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
description:
Get my 12 favorite biz ideas for 2024, with full launch plans included here: https://tkopod.co/youtubeD

I sat down with John Patten from Patten Properties (Airparkland.com + 844-900-Land) to explore the fascinating concept of Pecan Plantation, a fly-in neighborhood located an hour south of Dallas-Fort Worth.

This unique community features over 4,000 acres, homes on two airstrips, and even the ability to taxi your plane right to your house! In this episode, we discuss the legal aspects of running such a neighborhood, from liability and insurance to the lifestyle of living next to an airstrip.
